metadata.question: Were the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels higher over Shanghai than over Wuhan during April 20-May 12, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location): - Collection: Sentinel-5P NRTI NO2 (OFFL L3 is better but use NRTI as fallback if OFFL unavailable) - Band: tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density - Dates: 2020-04-20 to 2020-05-12 (inclusive) - Locations: Point for Shanghai (121.47, 31.23) and Wuhan (114.30, 30.59) 2. Masking strategy: - S5P L3 products come with qa_value; mask pixels with qa_value < 0.75 to keep high-quality retrievals. - Multiply by 1e6 to convert mol/m² to µmol/m² for readability. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - After filtering and masking, compute per-city mean via reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.mean()). - Check collection size; if 0 for any city → C1. - Check pixel count (count reducer); if 0 valid pixels in either ROI → C2. - If a computed mean is None or NaN → C3. - Otherwise compare Shanghai vs Wuhan; if Shanghai mean > Wuhan mean → A, else → B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') def s5p_no2_city_mean(lon, lat, name, start='2020-04-20', end='2020-05-12'): roi = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]) col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density') .filterDate(start, end) .filterBounds(roi) .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('qa_value').gte(0.75)))) n = col.size().getInfo() if n == 0: print(f"{name}: 0 images") return None, 0 img = col.mean().multiply(1e6) # µmol/m² count = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9).getInfo()['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'] mean = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=roi, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9).getInfo()['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'] print(f"{name}: Images={n}, Mean={mean:.2f} µmol/m², Pixels={int(count)}") return mean, count sh_mean, sh_cnt = s5p_no2_city_mean(121.47, 31.23, "Shanghai") wh_mean, wh_cnt = s5p_no2_city_mean(114.30, 30.59, "Wuhan") if sh_mean is None or wh_mean is None: print("C1") elif sh_cnt == 0 or wh_cnt == 0: print("C2") elif sh_mean is None or wh_mean is None or ee.Algorithms.IsNaN(ee.Number(sh_mean)).getInfo() or ee.Algorithms.IsNaN(ee.Number(wh_mean)).getInfo(): print("C3") else: print("A" if sh_mean > wh_mean else "B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

def s5p_no2_city_mean(lon, lat, name, start='2020-04-20', end='2020-05-12'):
    roi = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat])
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2')
           .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')
           .filterDate(start, end)
           .filterBounds(roi)
           .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('qa_value').gte(0.75))))
    n = col.size().getInfo()
    if n == 0:
        print(f"{name}: 0 images")
        return None, 0
    img = col.mean().multiply(1e6)  # µmol/m²
    count = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9).getInfo()['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density']
    mean = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=roi, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9).getInfo()['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density']
    print(f"{name}: Images={n}, Mean={mean:.2f} µmol/m², Pixels={int(count)}")
    return mean, count

sh_mean, sh_cnt = s5p_no2_city_mean(121.47, 31.23, "Shanghai")
wh_mean, wh_cnt = s5p_no2_city_mean(114.30, 30.59, "Wuhan")

if sh_mean is None or wh_mean is None:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif sh_cnt == 0 or wh_cnt == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif sh_mean is None or wh_mean is None or ee.Algorithms.IsNaN(ee.Number(sh_mean)).getInfo() or ee.Algorithms.IsNaN(ee.Number(wh_mean)).getInfo():
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>A</answer>" if sh_mean > wh_mean else "<answer>B</answer>")
